title: TikTok Advertising Policies, Creative Restrictions & Standards
overview: TikTok Advertising Policies ensure ad creative respects the TikTok community spirit, avoids deceptive practices, and adheres to global and regional regulatory restrictions.
coreConcepts: Three review layers: Automated text/image analysis, Audio recognition, and Human moderation
Creative consistency principle: ad text, video, audio, and landing page must tell a cohesive, honest story
Restricted age targeting for adult-themed products or regulated categories
Prohibition on third-party trademark infringement and unauthorized celebrity endorsements
features: TikTok Ad Review Status diagnostics (Approved, In Review, Rejected with reason codes)
Appeal submission tool directly inside TikTok Ads Manager
Creative Exchange portal connecting approved brands with verified creators
Commercial Content Disclosure toggle for creator-promoted content
bestPractices: Ensure video audio is clean, intelligible, and sourced from Commercial Music Library
Display authentic product functionality without false speed-ups or edited demonstrations
Ensure destination website is fully mobile-responsive and loads in under 3 seconds
Avoid shock-value hooks, flashing lights, or excessive fear-inducing problem hooks
policies: Prohibited: Illegal products, drugs, dangerous weapons, adult entertainment, get-rich-quick schemes
Restricted: Alcohol, financial services, dating, healthcare products, gambling
Landing page requirements: Working links, matching brand name, clear checkout terms, contact info
limitations: Review turnaround times typically 24 hours, but can extend to 48 hours during peak Q4 holidays
Frequent ad rejections decrease ad account health score and increase ad review latency
Advertisers cannot bid on political topics or social issue advocacy
commonIssues: Rejection for 'Sensational or Shocking Content' when using aggressive hook styles
Disapproval for 'Non-Functional Landing Page' due to slow mobile loading
Rejection due to commercial rights issues with background sound clips

troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Tone down visual contrast in the opening 2 seconds and remove overly dramatic text overlays
Test mobile landing page via Google PageSpeed Insights, remove popups that block content on mobile, and resubmit
